title: Fix unbounded dice/draw DoS vectors in server
description: Security audit found: roll_dice() accepts unbounded dice_count (u32), draw_cards() accepts unbounded draw_count. A malicious client can request billions of dice rolls causing OOM/CPU exhaustion. Add MAX_DICE_COUNT and MAX_DRAW_COUNT bounds in config.rs and validate in protocol.rs.
close_reason: Added MAX_DICE_COUNT (100), MAX_DRAW_COUNT (1000), MAX_DICE_FACES (1000), MAX_ZONE_NAME_LENGTH (128) to config.rs. Added validate_random_request() in protocol.rs with bounds for all random request types. Added dice_count bounds to validate_action(). Added state_hash format validation (64-char hex).
